0022600179.text: The Utah Jazz (1-6) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (3-4) for their eighth game of the season, with Utah on a five-game losing streak and 0-2 on the road, while New Orleans has won three straight. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), and New Orleans is missing Trey Murphy III (knee) and Yves Missi (knee bruise). The Jazz lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 120-119 win in Salt Lake City on October 23, though they lost all three meetings in 2025-26.
